# Commands

Everything the command line does. Run any of them with `--help` for the
full option list; this page is for finding out what exists.

Every command that checks a plate exits zero when nothing worse than a
warning was found, one when a rule reported an error, and two when the
command could not be carried out at all.

## `dragpoint crib`

List what the shop holds.

### `dragpoint crib cutters`

List the cutters in the crib.

| option | what it does | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print as JSON. |  |

### `dragpoint crib posts`

List the post processors.

### `dragpoint crib rules`

List the rules a plate is checked against.

| option | what it does | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print as JSON. |  |

### `dragpoint crib stock`

List the stock on the rack.

| option | what it does | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print as JSON. |  |

## `dragpoint font`

Look at the faces.

### `dragpoint font dump NAME`

Write a face back out in canonical .strk form.

| option | what it does | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--out` |  |  |

### `dragpoint font list`

List the faces that ship with dragpoint.

### `dragpoint font measure [TEXT...]`

Measure how wide a legend comes out.

| option | what it does | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--face` |  | `panelgothic` |
| `--cap-height` | Lettering height. | `3mm` |
| `--tracking` | Extra space per glyph. | `0mm` |
| `--condense` | Horizontal squeeze. | `1.0` |
| `--width` | Fit the legend into this width. |  |
| `--fit` |  | `none` |

### `dragpoint font show NAME`

Show one face and what it covers.

| option | what it does | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print the metrics as JSON. |  |

## `dragpoint job`

Work on a whole job.

### `dragpoint job check SCHEDULE`

Compile a schedule and print what the rules say.

| option | what it does | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--plate` | Check one plate rather than all of them. |  |
| `--quiet` | Say nothing, just set the exit code. |  |

### `dragpoint job nest SCHEDULE`

Lay the pieces out on the sheet the schedule names.

| option | what it does | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--no-rotate` | Keep every piece the way round it was drawn. |  |

### `dragpoint job post SCHEDULE`

Post every plate in a schedule, one file each.

| option | what it does | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--out` | Directory to write the programs into. |  |
| `--force` | Post plates that failed the rules. |  |

### `dragpoint job summary SCHEDULE`

Say what a job comes to without printing every violation.

### `dragpoint job time SCHEDULE`

Estimate how long a whole job takes.

| option | what it does | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--block-time` | Seconds a move costs. | `0.004` |

## `dragpoint plate`

Compile one plate.

### `dragpoint plate check [LINES...]`

Compile a plate and print what the rules say about it.

| option | what it does | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` | Plate name. | `PLATE` |
| `--size` | Plate size, WxH. | `60x20mm` |
| `--stock` | Stock code. | `LAM16-BW` |
| `--face` |  | `panelgothic` |
| `--cap-height` | Lettering height. | `3mm` |
| `--tracking` | Space per glyph. | `0mm` |
| `--condense` | Horizontal squeeze. | `1.0` |
| `--slant` | Oblique, in degrees. |  |
| `--mirror` | Cut it back to front. |  |
| `--fit` |  | `condense` |
| `--halign` |  | `centre` |
| `--valign` |  | `middle` |
| `--margin` | Engraving margin. | `2mm` |
| `--border` | Engraved border inset. |  |
| `--depth` | Cut depth, else the stock nominal. |  |
| `--cutter` | Cutter name, else the shop default. |  |
| `--arc` | Set the legend round this radius. |  |
| `--arc-start` | Degrees at the middle. | `90.0` |
| `--arc-sweep` | Degrees allowed. | `180.0` |
| `--arc-clockwise` | Run the legend the other way. |  |
| `--arc-inward` | Letters face the middle. |  |
| `--safe` | Full retract height. | `5mm` |
| `--clearance` | Hop height. | `0.5mm` |
| `--hop` | Lift high above this move. | `25mm` |
| `--no-optimise` | Leave the travel order alone. |  |
| `--pass-order` |  | `by-pass` |
| `--rapid-rate` | Rapid mm/min. | `6000.0` |
| `--quiet` | Say nothing, just set the exit code. |  |
